services.title: Product Discovery & Strategy
services.shortDescription: We help transform early ideas into validated product opportunities through market research, customer insights, and strategic planning.
services.fullDescription: Our discovery process bridges the gap between vision and market realities. We validate core assumptions, prioritize features, and define a clear roadmap to ensure your software development investment delivers high-impact results.

services.title: Software & App Development
services.shortDescription: We design, develop, and maintain custom digital products that solve real-world problems and support business growth.
services.fullDescription: From high-performance web platforms to native-quality mobile solutions and scalable microservices, our engineering team constructs maintainable, performant, and resilient applications.

services.title: AI Prompting
services.shortDescription: Learn how to guide powerful AI assistants with clear instructions, relevant context, structured prompts, and effective evaluation.
services.fullDescription: Prompt engineering is the systematic discipline of instructing existing artificial intelligence models to produce more relevant, accurate, and high-value outputs across commercial workflows.

services.title: AI Development
services.shortDescription: We engineer intelligent software systems using machine learning, AI models, data processing, and modern software development practices.
services.fullDescription: We build proprietary AI-driven features, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines, intelligent recommendation engines, and automated data processing tools that give modern enterprises a strategic advantage.

services.title: Cloud & Infrastructure
services.shortDescription: We design and manage scalable infrastructure that supports reliable applications, efficient deployment, and business continuity.
services.fullDescription: Modern applications require bulletproof uptime and rapid deployment pipelines. We implement containerization, automated CI/CD, cloud architecture, and proactive telemetry.

services.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance
services.shortDescription: We help organizations identify security risks, strengthen digital systems, protect data, and improve compliance readiness.
services.fullDescription: Security is integral to engineering. We conduct authorized vulnerability assessments, establish robust data protection architectures, configure secure access controls, and train teams on security best practices.

services.title: IT Staff Augmentation
services.shortDescription: We help organizations scale their technical capabilities by providing dedicated professionals who support software delivery, design, and product management.
services.fullDescription: Augment your development velocity with vetted engineers, designers, and product leaders trained to integrate seamlessly into your existing sprints, repositories, and culture.
keyOfferings: AI, data, and technical project support

programs.title: AI Prompting & LLM Interaction
programs.prerequisites: Basic computer literacy and curiosity about modern artificial intelligence tools.
programs.description: Master the art and science of prompt engineering. Learn how to guide leading AI models with structured instructions, contextual anchors, system framing, and output schema evaluation.
curriculum: Module 1: Principles of Generative AI and Token Economics
Module 2: Zero-Shot, Few-Shot, and Chain-of-Thought Prompting
Module 3: Structured Data Extraction & Schema Enforcement
Module 4: Enterprise Workflow Automation & Prompt Testing
Module 5: Responsible AI, Bias Mitigation & Capstone Project

programs.title: AI Development & Machine Learning
programs.prerequisites: Foundational programming knowledge in Python or JavaScript.
programs.description: A comprehensive immersion into training, fine-tuning, and integrating modern AI architectures. Build retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) engines, embedding search pipelines, and predictive algorithms.
curriculum: Module 1: Python for Data Science and Machine Learning
Module 2: Neural Networks & Deep Learning Foundations
Module 3: Embeddings, Vector Stores, and RAG Architecture
Module 4: API Integration with Gemini and Open-Source Models
Module 5: Production Deployment and Scalable Model Serving

programs.title: Full-Stack Web Development
programs.prerequisites: Commitment to 12+ hours weekly. Prior coding interest encouraged but not required.
programs.description: Learn modern software engineering from first principles to full deployment. Build production-grade web applications using React, TypeScript, Node.js, REST APIs, and relational databases.
curriculum: Module 1: Modern JavaScript & TypeScript Engineering
Module 2: Component Architecture with React & Tailwind CSS
Module 3: Server Architecture, REST APIs & Express.js
Module 4: Relational Databases, SQL & Authentication Systems
Module 5: Git Workflows, Testing, CI/CD & Cloud Deployment

programs.title: Mobile App Development
programs.description: Craft beautiful, high-performance cross-platform mobile apps for iOS and Android. Cover state management, camera/sensor hardware integration, offline caching, and app store deployment.
curriculum: Module 1: React Native & Expo Fundamentals
Module 2: Mobile UI/UX Patterns & Touch Navigation
Module 3: Local Storage, SQLite & Offline First Architecture
Module 4: Push Notifications & Backend Integration
Module 5: Performance Optimization & App Store Packaging

programs.title: UI/UX Design & Product Interface
programs.prerequisites: Interest in visual aesthetics, empathy, and product usability.
programs.description: Develop the skills needed to design intuitive, accessible digital products. Master Figma, wireframing, high-fidelity prototypes, user research interviews, and responsive design systems.
curriculum: Module 1: Design Thinking & User Research Methods
Module 2: Information Architecture & Wireframing
Module 3: Visual Hierarchy, Typography & Color Systems in Figma
Module 4: Interactive Prototyping & Usability Testing
Module 5: Developer Handoff & Design System Maintenance

programs.title: Cloud Computing & DevOps Architecture
programs.prerequisites: Familiarity with terminal/command line and basic networking concepts.
programs.description: Master modern infrastructure operations, containerization with Docker, Kubernetes orchestration, Infrastructure as Code, and automated deployment pipelines on major cloud providers.
curriculum: Module 1: Linux Administration & Cloud Networking Fundamentals
Module 2: Containerization with Docker & Multi-stage Builds
Module 3: CI/CD Automation with GitHub Actions
Module 4: Kubernetes Cluster Architecture & Monitoring
Module 5: Security Hardening & Zero-Downtime Deployment

programs.title: Cybersecurity & Compliance Fundamentals
programs.prerequisites: Basic understanding of computer networks and operating systems.
programs.description: Learn foundational defensive security, vulnerability analysis within authorized scope, identity and access management, encryption protocols, and compliance framework readiness.
curriculum: Module 1: Security Principles, Threat Modeling & Ethics
Module 2: Network Defense, Firewalls & Traffic Inspection
Module 3: Authorized Web Application Vulnerability Assessment
Module 4: Cryptography & Identity Access Management (IAM)
Module 5: Incident Triage & Data Privacy Compliance

programs.title: Product Discovery & Tech Strategy
programs.prerequisites: Aspiring product managers, startup founders, or business analysts.
programs.description: Learn how to de-risk technology investments before writing code. Formulate customer hypotheses, validate market demand, prioritize features, and draft crisp technical roadmaps.
curriculum: Module 1: Problem Space Definition & Customer Discovery
Module 2: Competitor Landscape & Market Opportunity Sizing
Module 3: MVP Scoping & Feature Prioritization Matrices
Module 4: Metrics That Matter: Product Analytics & KPIs
Module 5: Pitching to Engineering Teams & Stakeholder Alignment
